composition_subtypes.role: sort by decreasing a_i for audience selection
DP over position bitmask iterating sorted people

payload.core_composition_summary: Sort people by descending a_i, then DP over bitmask (size 2^p) to choose players and top k audience.
payload.rationale: Sorting ensures that when DP decides to take a person as audience, they are among the best remaining a_i, enabling correct max.
